title: The garden notebook

title: Snowy's new house
text: Hannah's rabbit has a new house in the garden. Her dad (A) it last weekend. It is (B) than the old one, so Snowy has more space. Hannah checks his water every morning before she (C) to school. text: Isabel is helping at the school book fair. There are many books on the tables, but she cannot see (A) books about trains. Her friend Ben says he has one at home. text: Freya planned a picnic, but the rain did not stop. Her friends (A) to her house instead. They put a blanket on the sitting-room floor and sat around it. title: Painting the town
text: Poppy is painting a winter picture for a competition. She usually (A) pencils, but today she wants to try paint. Her dad gave her a set of six (B) yesterday. title: A day at the museum
text: Daisy's class visited the science museum yesterday. Their bus (A) outside the main entrance at nine. A guide showed the children two model (B). title: Breakfast for Dad
text: Amelie and Rose are making a birthday breakfast. Yesterday, they (A) bananas and oats at the shop. Now Amelie is stirring the porridge while Rose cuts the fruit. title: The music room
text: Florence is a new member of the music group. She (A) the guitar every evening after her homework. Last Monday, the teacher (B) her to sing with two other pupils. title: Paper birds
text: Matilda invited her new neighbour to a craft afternoon. Nina (A) a bag of coloured paper with her. The girls sat at the kitchen table and made paper birds. title: Helping the younger pupils
text: Beatrice helped at the sports day last Thursday. She (A) a yellow shirt so the younger children could find her. There were ten beanbags in (B) basket. title: By the lake
text: Harriet is on holiday with her family. Yesterday, they (A) a boat and rowed across the lake. The water was (B) than Harriet expected, so she did not swim. title: Our first newspaper
text: Imogen and her classmates are making a newspaper. It is their (A) issue: they have never made one before. Yesterday, Jack (B) a map of the playground. Imogen wrote a story about the school cat. title: Eggs from the farm
text: Eliza visited a farm on Saturday. The farmer (A) the visitors how to collect eggs carefully. Eliza carried a small basket while her cousin opened the gate. title: Four books for summer
text: Phoebe joined the reading challenge in July. She (A) her first book in three days. It was about a lost puppy. Now she is reading a book about space. She thinks it is (B) than the puppy story. title: An interesting photograph
text: Evelyn went on a walk with the photography club yesterday. She (A) a picture of an old green door. There were two small (B) above it.
